from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json,os,subprocess,time,signal,statistics
wd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];task=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
prior=json.loads((wd/'.local/tool-tasks/open-potion-primary-proof-20261007/pure-final-summary.json').read_text())
control=wd/'.local/tool-tasks/open-potion-primary-proof-20261007/build-candidate-v4/CombatSolver.dll'
candidate=task/'build-guard-v3/CombatSolver.dll'
assert sha256(control.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='fb2f15c5f0684f88a0645c841b5b5850a34fa36e8ba5ccc0e4757a62dafac4b8'
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_','COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY','COMBATSOLVER_JOINT_','COMBATSOLVER_FINITE_')) and k not in ('COMPlus_PerfMapEnabled','DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled')}
runs=[];summaries=[]
scenes=['dev-03-regent-elite','dev-00-ironclad-elite','dev-01-silent-elite','dev-02-defect-elite',
 'dev-04-necrobinder-elite','dev-09-necrobinder-boss','dev-06-silent-boss','dev-08-regent-boss',
 'holdout-03-regent','native-infested','native-soul-nexus']
source_hashes={p:sha256(Path(wd/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in json.loads((task/'guard-sources.json').read_text())}
def persist():
 (task/'guard-regression-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(runs=runs,sceneSummaries=summaries,
  productionSourceSha256=source_hashes,scope='Final candidate full Coordinator serial A1/C1/C2/A2; no diagnostic/profiler/correctness instrumentation'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(scene,label):
 reference=next(r for r in prior['runs'] if r['scene']==scene and r['label']=='C1')
 command=reference['plan']['command'].copy();out=task/'guard-regression'/scene/label;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 command[command.index('--out')+1]=str(out);command[command.index('--label')+1]='native-callback-guard-final-'+scene+'-'+label
 dll=control if label.startswith('A') else candidate;thisenv=dict(env,OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL=str(dll))
 plan=dict(scene=scene,label=label,command=command,outerTimeoutSeconds=120,
  dllSha256=sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  requestSha256=sha256(Path(command[command.index('--request')+1]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),noProfilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation=True)
 (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n');started=time.perf_counter()
 with (out/'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
  process=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=wd,env=thisenv,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
  try:code=process.wait(timeout=120)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
   os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
   try:process.wait(timeout=5)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);process.wait()
   raise
 raw=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text());policy=json.loads((out/'search-policy.json').read_text());root_hash=sha256(raw['rootContinuationStamp'].encode()).hexdigest()
 baseline=reference['comparisonQuality'];actual=raw['comparisonQuality'];quality_identical=baseline==actual
 quality_ok=quality_identical;comparison=None
 if not quality_identical:
  pair=out/'quality-pair.json';comp=out/'quality-comparison.json'
  pair.write_text(json.dumps([dict(id=scene+'-'+label,candidate=str(out/'quality.json'),
   baseline=str(Path(reference['plan']['command'][reference['plan']['command'].index('--out')+1])/'quality.json'))],indent=2)+'\n')
  compare_cmd=['dotnet',command[1],'--compare-quality-batch',str(pair),str(comp)]
  compared=subprocess.run(compare_cmd,cwd=wd,env=thisenv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
  assert compared.returncode==0,compared.stdout+compared.stderr
  comparison=json.loads(comp.read_text())[0]
  quality_ok=(comparison['comparison']<=0 and comparison['materialComparison']<=0
   and actual['projectedBattleHpLost']<=baseline['projectedBattleHpLost']
   and actual['deathSaveUseCount']<=baseline['deathSaveUseCount'])
 checks=dict(root=reference['rootStampSha256']==root_hash,budget=reference['budget']==raw['budget'],
  policy=reference['policy']==policy,qualityNotRegressed=quality_ok,
  noTimeBoundary=not raw['timeBoundaryObserved'])
 quality_raw=json.loads((out/'quality.json').read_text())
 checks['noNewRisk']=not quality_raw['snapshot']['hasRisk']
 record=dict(scene=scene,label=label,status=raw['status'],exitCode=code,launcherWallSeconds=time.perf_counter()-started,
  wallSeconds=raw['wallSeconds'],peakProcessWorkingSetBytes=raw['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'],
  comparisonQuality=actual,qualityIdentical=quality_identical,qualityComparison=comparison,checks=checks,
  rootStampSha256=root_hash,budget=raw['budget'],policy=policy,solverMetrics=raw['solverMetrics'],
  pruneCounters=raw['pruneCounters'],plan=plan)
 runs.append(record);persist()
 print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('scene','label','status','wallSeconds','peakProcessWorkingSetBytes','checks','comparisonQuality')},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 assert code==0 and raw['status']=='Passed' and all(checks.values())
for scene in scenes:
 for label in ('A1','C1','C2','A2'):run(scene,label)
 a=[r for r in runs if r['scene']==scene and r['label'].startswith('A')];c=[r for r in runs if r['scene']==scene and r['label'].startswith('C')]
 am=statistics.mean(r['wallSeconds'] for r in a);cm=statistics.mean(r['wallSeconds'] for r in c)
 rss=max(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in c)/max(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in a)-1
 summaries.append(dict(scene=scene,controlMeanSeconds=am,candidateMeanSeconds=cm,speedup=am/cm,
  peakRssChange=rss,qualityNotRegressed=True,qualityIdentical=all(r['qualityIdentical'] for r in c),
  controlQuality=a[0]['comparisonQuality'],candidateQualities=[r['comparisonQuality'] for r in c]))
 persist();print(json.dumps(summaries[-1],ensure_ascii=False),flush=True);assert rss<=0.10
assert all(sha256(Path(wd/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest for p,digest in source_hashes.items())
print('FINAL_REGRESSION_PASSED requests='+str(len(runs)),flush=True)
